summary: Europe's second-largest ecosystem by VC raised, led by Berlin and Munich with strong hubs in Hamburg, Cologne and Leipzig. Strengths in deep tech, AI, mobility, industrial tech and fintech; notable successes include Celonis, N26, Delivery Hero and Personio.

summary: One of Europe's top two or three ecosystems, centred on Paris (Station F) with strong regional hubs in Lyon, Lille, Grenoble and Toulouse. company_setup: SAS is standard (from €1 capital); register online via the guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); typically 1–2 weeks; foreigners can incorporate remotely but need a French address and bank account.
